page.notes: Printed page with running head NOTÆ., page number 179, and gathering signature Aa 3. Catchword "sicut" at lower right. The text begins mid-sentence, so the first paragraph continues from the previous page. The text is one paragraph with interleaved Arabic and Greek lines. Doubtful readings: the Greek word after "His" (printed as ὡσαύτως, roughly legible); the last word of the page, "abiis", which may be "abiit" (marked [?]); the Arabic lines are copied as best read and may contain errors. The Latin word "[apud Deum?]" is in square brackets as printed. The catchword "sicut" is also the first word of the next page, so it has been placed in the bottom margin, and the final text line ends with "abiis" [?]. The right margin is empty, with no notes.
